about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Awaze Beef Tibs with Peppers
recipes.summary: Quick-seared Ethiopian beef tibs with onion, capsicum and a spiced awaze-style chilli paste, served with rice.
steps: Mix the chilli powder, paprika, cardamom, cumin, 1/2 tsp salt and the water into a thin spice paste.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Melt the butter in a large pan over high heat and sear the beef in two batches for 3 minutes each until browned outside. Lift out.
Fry the onion for 5 minutes until golden, then add the garlic, ginger, capsicum and jalapeño for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the spice paste for 1 minute, return the beef and toss for 2 minutes until coated and hot through. Serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until browned all over and the centre reaches at least 63°C, resting it briefly.
Ethiopia. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Cape Malay Denningvleis Tamarind Lamb
recipes.summary: A slow-cooked Cape Malay lamb stew sweet and sour with tamarind, bay and allspice, falling apart over yellow rice.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat for 8 minutes in batches until deeply coloured. Lift out.
Cook the onion in the same pot for 6 minutes until soft and golden, then add the garlic, allspice and cinnamon for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the lamb with the tamarind, sugar, bay, 1 tsp salt and water. Cover and simmer gently for 90 minutes until the lamb is very tender and the sauce thick.
Cook the rice with the turmeric and sultana by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Serve the lamb and sauce over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until tender and at least 75°C in the centre; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Cape Malay. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Fijian Coconut Curry Fish with Pumpkin
recipes.summary: Fijian-style fish in a gentle turmeric coconut curry with pumpkin and a little heat, served with rice.

items: 600g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and turmeric and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk, add the pumpkin and chilli, and simmer for 12 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Nestle in the fish and simmer for 5 minutes until opaque and flaking. Squeeze over the lime and season with salt.
Serve the curry over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flakes easily, to at least 63°C, and eat the same day.
Fiji. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Samaki wa Kupaka Swahili Grilled Fish in Coconut Tamarind
recipes.summary: Coastal Swahili fish grilled and coated in a coconut, tamarind and cumin sauce, with coconut-flavoured rice.
steps: Season the fish with turmeric and salt. Cook the rice with the extra 1/2 cup coconut milk and water by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the fish for 3 minutes each side until golden and just cooked. Lift onto a tray.
In the same pan, fry the garlic, cumin, coriander and chilli for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the coconut milk and tamarind and simmer for 6 minutes until slightly thick.
Return the fish and spoon over the sauce for 2 minutes until heated through.
Serve with the rice and lime wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until it flakes easily and reaches 63°C; eat the same day.
Swahili coast. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Devilled Chicken
recipes.summary: Sri Lankan style devilled chicken: crisp fried pieces tossed in a sweet, sour and chilli sauce with capsicum and onion.

items: 700g chicken thigh, cut in bite-size pieces

steps: Toss the chicken with the cornflour, egg and a pinch of salt. Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 170C and fry the chicken in batches for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through. Drain on paper.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp of oil. Stir-fry the onion and capsicum for 3 minutes until just tender but still bright.
Add the garlic, ginger and chilli flakes for 30 seconds until fragrant, then the tomato sauce, sweet chilli sauce, soy and vinegar. Simmer for 2 minutes until glossy.
Toss the chicken through the sauce for 1 minute until coated and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: fry the chicken until golden and cooked through to at least 75°C, and keep the eggs fully cooked.
Sri Lanka. Dinner.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Ambul Thiyal Sour Fish Curry
recipes.summary: Southern Sri Lankan sour fish curry, dry-cooked with black pepper and goraka-style tamarind until dark and sticky.

items: 600g white fish fillet, cut in 3cm cubes

steps: Mix the tamarind, pepper, turmeric, garlic, ginger and salt into a paste and coat the fish in it.
Put the tuna in a wide pan with the curry leaf, cinnamon stick, coconut oil and water.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 12 minutes until the fish is cooked through and the liquid is almost gone.
Uncover and cook for 5 minutes, stirring gently, until the pieces are dark, dry and coated.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, and serve with the fish.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until it reaches 63°C in the thickest part; eat the same day.
Sri Lanka. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Dak Bokkeumtang Korean Braised Chicken and Potatoes
recipes.summary: Korean spicy braised chicken with potato and carrot in a gochujang and soy sauce that turns sticky and glossy.
steps: Mix the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, honey, garlic and sesame oil in a large pot, then stir in the water.
Add the chicken and bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the potato, carrot and onion, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Uncover and cook on medium-high for 8 minutes until the sauce is thick and glossy and the chicken is cooked through.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then serve the chicken and sauce over it.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the juices run clear and it reaches 75°C.
Korea. Dinner.

recipes.title: Khua Kling Southern Thai Dry Pork Curry
recipes.summary: Fiery dry-fried southern Thai pork with turmeric, lemongrass and makrut lime leaf, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat and fry the curry paste, turmeric, lemongrass and garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the pork and stir-fry over high heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until fully cooked and dry with no liquid left.
Add the fish sauce, palm sugar, chilli and lime leaf and stir for 2 minutes until the pork is dark and aromatic.
Serve with the rice and cucumber slices.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains.
Southern Thailand. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Bo Kho Vietnamese Beef Stew with Carrot
recipes.summary: Vietnamese lemongrass beef stew with star anise, carrot and tomato, thick with annatto-coloured sauce, eaten with.
steps: Warm the oil with the annatto seed in a small pan for 1 minute until the oil turns orange, then strain and discard the seed.
Brown the beef in the orange oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until coloured. Add the shallot and garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste, lemongrass, star anise, cinnamon, fish sauce and water. Cover and simmer gently for 80 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the carrot and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until the carrot is soft and the sauce thick.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy. Serve the stew over the rice with coriander.
notes: Food safety: simmer the beef until tender and at least 75°C in the centre; cool and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Vietnam. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ayam Bakar Taliwang Lombok Grilled Chicken
recipes.summary: Lombok chilli-garlic chicken roasted until charred, brushed with a spicy sweet sambal and served with rice.
steps: Blend the chillies, shallot, garlic, tomato and shrimp paste to a coarse paste. Fry in the oil in a pan for 10 minutes until darkened and the oil separates.
Stir in the kecap manis, palm sugar, lime juice and 1 tsp salt, then cool slightly.
Toss the chicken in half the sambal and roast on a tray at 200C for 30 minutes, turning once, until deep brown and cooked through.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Brush the chicken with the remaining sambal and grill for 3 minutes until charred at the edges, then serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: roast the chicken until it reaches 75°C at the thickest part and the juices run clear.
Lombok. Dinner.

recipes.title: Ikan Bakar Malaysian Foil-Baked Fish with Sambal
recipes.summary: Malaysian banana-leaf-style fish baked in foil with a chilli, lemongrass and shrimp paste sambal, served with rice.
steps: Blend the chillies, shallot, garlic, lemongrass, shrimp paste and tamarind to a paste. Fry in the oil for 6 minutes until darkened and fragrant, then add the palm sugar and 1/2 tsp salt.
Spread the sambal over both sides of each fish fillet and wrap each in foil, sealing the edges.
Bake the parcels at 200C for 15 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Open the parcels and finish under the grill for 3 minutes until the sambal caramelises. Serve with the rice, cucumber and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until it reaches 63°C and flakes easily; eat the same day.
Malaysia. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Oxtail Kare-Kare Filipino Peanut Stew
recipes.summary: Filipino oxtail stew in a rich peanut sauce with green beans and eggplant, traditionally served with a salty.
steps: Simmer the oxtail in the water for 2 hours, skimming, until the meat is tender and pulls from the bone. Lift out and keep 3 cups of the broth.
Warm the oil with the annatto seed for 1 minute until the oil turns orange, then strain out the seed. Cook the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Whisk in the peanut butter and the reserved broth and simmer for 15 minutes until thick and glossy, seasoning with the fish sauce.
Add the oxtail, eggplant and green beans and simmer for 10 minutes until tender, adding the bok choy for the final 2 minutes until wilted.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy. Serve with the stew and shrimp paste on the side.
notes: Food safety: simmer the oxtail until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Visayan and Luzon tradition. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Rajasthani Laal Maas Fiery Lamb
recipes.summary: A Rajasthani fiery red lamb curry cooked in ghee with Kashmiri chilli, garlic and yoghurt, hot but richly flavoured.
steps: Soak the dried chillies in hot water for 15 minutes, then blend with the garlic and Kashmiri chilli powder to a smooth paste.
Heat the ghee in a heavy pot over medium heat and fry the cumin seed, coriander seed, cardamom, bay and cinnamon for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the onion and cook for 10 minutes until deep golden.
Add the lamb and brown for 8 minutes, then stir in the chilli paste for 3 minutes until the oil rises. Whisk in the yoghurt gradually so it does not split.
Add the water and 1 tsp salt, cover and simmer for 75 minutes until the lamb is very tender and the sauce is thick and red.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, and serve with the lamb.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until tender and at least 75°C in the centre; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Rajasthan. Dinner. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Loco Moco Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Hawaiian loco moco: rice topped with a beef patty, a runny fried egg and onion gravy.
steps: Mix the beef mince with the egg, breadcrumbs and 1/2 tsp salt, shape into 4 patties. Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Fry the patties in a pan over medium heat for 5 minutes each side until browned and cooked through. Rest them on a plate.
Cook the onion in 1 tbsp butter for 6 minutes until golden. Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer for 4 minutes until it thickens into gravy.
Fry the 4 eggs in the remaining butter for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks stay soft.
Pile rice into bowls, add a patty, an egg, spoon over the gravy and scatter with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the patties until they reach 75°C in the centre; cook the egg whites firm. Avoid soft yolks for vulnerable eaters.
Hawaii. Lunch.
